Oracle Investment Management Maintains Stake in Opko Health (OPK); Apple (AAPL) Stock Price Declined While Private Wealth Advisors Trimmed Holding by $463,398
May 26, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Oracle Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Opko Health Inc (OPK) by 5.22% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oracle Investment Management Inc bought 190,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 35.16% with the market. The hedge fund held 3.83 million shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.75 million, up from 3.64M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oracle Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Opko Health Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.07 billion market cap company. It closed at $3.7 lastly. It is down 60.81% downtrending. It has underperformed by 72.36% the S&P500.
Private Wealth Advisors Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.08% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Private Wealth Advisors Inc sold 2,742 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 86,353 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.61 million, down from 89,095 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Private Wealth Advisors Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
